overview: Fuel Uplift Reconciliation and Leakage addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in aviation and airports operations. The first proof of value uses flight plans, metered uplifts and fuel contracts. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is unreconciled litres per flight, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: flight plans, metered uplifts and fuel contracts; define unreconciled litres per flight and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Airport COO / Airline Operations Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for unreconciled litres per flight
